title: Juicy Smoky French Fish Papillote
description: A smoky and flaky French dish featuring lime leaves, perfect for a brunch mood, and friendly to Buddhist temple dietary preferences
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the cod fish fillets and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together lemon juice, olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Place a cod fish fillet in the center of each parchment paper sheet.
Brush the lemon juice mixture evenly over both sides of the fish fillets.
Place 3 lime leaves on top of each fish fillet.
Fold the parchment paper over the fish to create a papillote, and twist the ends to seal.
Place the papillotes on a baking sheet and bake for 12 minutes.
Remove the papillotes from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes before serving.
